title: Noor's Gourmet Food
summary: A packaging system for a growing line of halal food products — spices, coffee, teas, jams and more.

stats.label: label system across every product line

caseStudy.brief: Noor's Gourmet Food was growing a range of halal food products, from spice powders and coffee to herbal teas, jams, juices and ready-to-eat dishes, and each new product needed packaging.
caseStudy.did: As Packaging Designer and Brand Developer I designed the packaging for more than fifteen of these products.
decisions: Each product line has its own colour story and photography, so it stands apart on the shelf.
The gold Noor seal, the halal and satisfaction marks and a consistent label structure tie the whole range together as one brand.
